title: noccaea tenuis
intro: Noccaea tenuis, commonly known as Teesdale saxifrage, is a flowering plant species in the mustard family, Brassicaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Noccaea tenuis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe and calm irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
